dogecoin.text: A dogecoin spinoff! How much is this actually going to translate into real money that can be spent on relief? He just made up this ‘money’. If he’d converted it into real money first it would be a magnificent donation. But …. Hope I am very wrong.

@BetterCity Up to a point. Financiers can be creative but products/services need to be created. Shilling for Dogecoin does not make one ‘a creator’.
And other sources of finance are available. VC money is often the wrong money (see WeWork for the perfect example).
